why: Evidence that lives OUTSIDE the repository and outside ARGUS's own state, declared so that it is never silently absent: each item reports AVAILABLE_LOCALLY, NOT_MOUNTED (this process cannot see the root, for instance inside a container) or RECOVERABLE / MISSING (the root is visible and the item is not). ARGUS never writes to an EXTERNAL_READ_ONLY root. This public build declares one neutral example root; replace it with your own.

roots.note: an example root. Set ARGUS_EXTERNAL_MOUNTS to a JSON object mapping this id to a real directory to see the item below as available; until then it reports NOT_MOUNTED, which means unknown, not lost.

items.label: Example: a local mirror of public open data

recovery.source: the public Vesuvius Challenge open-data bucket
recovery.note: re-fetchable; declare your own roots and items in this file
